resources.string: BFU mode uses device-protected storage before the first unlock. Magisk root is verified; the current milestone probes /data/local/debian storage access for a future systemd launcher. Never place passwords, tokens, or other credentials in BFU storage.
Debian boot requires Magisk root on every cold boot. Authorize this shared UID while Android is unlocked, and choose Magisk’s permanent/forever option so no approval UI is needed during BFU.

Continue only if every listed app is trusted. In Magisk, select the permanent/forever duration; a one-time grant will not work after a cold reboot.

Rootfs installation runs only after unlock. In Termux, first run: pkg install debootstrap util-linux. The app downloads pinned official Debian artifacts, verifies SHA-256, and builds a staging tree before publishing /data/local/debian.
Enable Direct Boot Debian bootstrap before installing.
Unlock Android before installing the Debian rootfs.
This downloads Debian packages and runs upstream debootstrap as pre-authorized Magisk root. Existing /data/local/debian is never overwritten. Keep this app open to watch the live log.
